about.title: BoxVault
about.description: BoxVault is a self-hosted solution designed to store and manage Virtual Machine templates.

details.nodejs: Node.js service that also answers Vagrant's box API on the same paths
details.auth: Local accounts, single sign-on through OpenID Connect providers, and service-account tokens for automation
details.endpoints: REST API documented in the Swagger UI at /api-docs
details.database: Organizations, boxes, versions, providers, architectures and ISOs in the database; files on local storage

details.react: React single-page app with the navbar and pages shared byte for byte with the provisioner catalog
details.interface: Light and dark themes, English and Spanish, browser notifications
details.features: Box and ISO upload, versions, providers and architectures, organization console, admin panel

about.goal: To provide a robust and easy-to-use platform for managing Vagrant boxes.
